rationale: Site Engineer for Regal Innovations civil and public domain works in Sydney; duties centre on supporting site and project managers, ordering materials, reading drawings and specifications, QA records and safety, which overlap Marc's 2019 to 2020 Philippines site work (coordinating crews, reviewing drawings, inspections, material records, progress reports).

Advert asks for a civil engineering qualification, driver's licence and White Card, MS Office and AutoCAD: Marc holds a BSCE (2019), Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design (Feb 2026), licence, White Card and AutoCAD from study.
No citizenship or PR gate and no minimum years stated; offer mentions mentoring and training on Tier 1 projects. Salary $85k to $100k suggests some experience is expected.
caution: Advert asks for a proven track record delivering civil infrastructure, landscaping, earthworks or public domain projects and experience tracking variations and cost control; Marc's site experience is about a year in the Philippines (building renovation and subdivision finishing works) and he has no Australian site experience. Sydney relocation must be confirmed by Marc.
